features: Home owns six connected readline, terminal and performance registry modules and four native histogram/TTY sources.
Pinned readline completion/display behavior and Node performance entry observers execute from the owned module graph.
Native histogram uses standard quiet NaN without a suppressed macro; generation invalidates on every selected external class header.
limitations: The TERM=dumb run retains 25 registered failures and seven skipped files; capable-terminal final run preserves original assertions and deadlines and executes all 31 files.
Older upstream host Bun loses captured child stderr during relative discovery; installed newer host and final Home ABI gates are independently recorded.
Compiler failures, outer ABI timeout and disk refusal are retained without passing credit.

Performance utilization/timing/resource APIs, independent delay-monitor lifetime, remaining module/native dependencies, complete Bun suite and Release/ASAN/all-platform parity are not established by this checkpoint.
